Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a study on helicopter access for emergencies in a certain local jurisdiction.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to helicopter access for emergencies; creating anew section; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The aviation division of the department oftransportation, in partnership with the state military department, thecity of Seattle, King county, and the Washington state patrol, shallform a committee comprised of at least one and no more than threerepresentatives from each entity to study the adequacy of theinfrastructure in downtown Seattle to support helicopter access todowntown Seattle. The study must examine the need for helicopteraccess to downtown Seattle during a major emergency, the ability tosupport that need, how Seattle compares with other major cities in itsability to accommodate helicopters, and make recommendations forimprovements, with particular emphasis on the city's ability to performair evacuations in emergencies. The committee shall report itsfindings to the joint transportation committee by January 1, 2009.

The sum of two hundred fifty thousanddollars, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for p. 1 SB 6920the biennium ending June 30, 2009, from the multimodal transportationaccount to the department of transportation for the purposes of thisact.
